title: Add D&D level-1 equipment and proficiency choice flow
description:
Add guided handling for D&D level-1 equipment, armor/weapon proficiencies, tools, languages, and class/background proficiency choices once the required metadata exists.

Expected UX
- Present choice groups separately instead of one giant prompt.
- Multi-select choices should show how many selections remain.
- Invalid selections should not reset the group.
- Review should show completed and missing mechanical choices.

Acceptance criteria
- Fighter-like class can choose required skills and starting equipment.
- Background-derived proficiencies/equipment are represented.
- Missing required choices block finalization with direct navigation to fix.
- Tests cover at least one class skill choice group and one equipment choice group.
notes: Review fix pushed to PR #311: satisfied mechanical choices are now editable. class-choices no longer skips satisfied groups; a satisfied group opens in edit mode (Enter keep / clear redo / single-pick replace); clear/reset available mid-group; review jumps back to class-choices (goto-choices nav) instead of misleading 'back' wording. Tests: resume correction (clear+re-pick, others preserved) + clear mid-group. verify:worktree green (2566 passed/19 skipped).
close_reason: Merged via PR #311. Interactive class-choices step collects skills/tools/equipment/languages group-by-group (engine.setChoice + mechanicalChoices); invalid/duplicate rejected without reset; satisfied groups editable on re-entry (keep/clear/replace); review lists completed/pending and jumps back to class-choices when pending. isFinalizable/toFinalizableDraft unchanged (b69j.14 folds choices into record). No importer/frozen-pack files.
